sentences.text: Is Lionel Messi the greatest of all time?
sentences.editorial: the question the video leaves with the viewer

sentences.text: Start with the awards: a record eight Ballons d'Or.
Four hundred and seventy-four La Liga goals, a record, and seventy-three in a single season.
Two trebles with Barcelona, in 2009 and 2015.
In 2022, he led Argentina to the World Cup.
In sampled matches, his key passes per ninety minutes more than doubled.
The greatest of all time: you decide.
sentences.editorial: hands the question back to the viewer
